decisions.title: Lane identity is AgentEntry.name
decisions.rationale: local, remote, SDK, and endpoint lanes can fail or rate-limit independently; provider grouping remains explicit

decisions.title: Pricing remains owned by dg-00 model_catalog
decisions.rationale: registry projects exact model rows and request quotes without a second price store or heuristic publisher join

decisions.title: Explicit config-sourced location
decisions.rationale: dg-04 needs a typed local/cloud/unknown constraint and must not infer it from lane names or catalog publishers

decisions.title: Bound and authorize rate-limit state
decisions.rationale: atomic RPC replay, finite resets, explicit reporting capability, audit, and compaction make live state safe under concurrency
